Definition: from G4023; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed):--place.
BiblicalUsage: Perioche is a passage of Scripture, a portion marked off. The place of the Scripture the Ethiopian read was this: He was led as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb dumb before His shearer, so He opened not His mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that one passage can open the whole gospel: the eunuch read Isaiah, and Philip preached Jesus from it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
